result.reasoning_summary: Patch implements FW-RANSOM-04 bounded SMB propagation correlation with deterministic, tenant-isolated event correlation over caller-supplied observations. All core requirements met: exact uppercase-token matching, device/event/window bounds enforced before audit, one-tenant isolation, duplicate (device_id, event_id) deduplication, evidence-first validation pattern, warn-only recommendations, hardcoded DRY_RUN/DETECT_ONLY mode/action, and no network operations. Input validation rejects non-DRY_RUN observations. Frozen dataclass ensures immutability. Four comprehensive tests cover happy path, token exactness, cross-tenant rejection, bounds enforcement before evidence write, and audit failure handling. No modifications to existing ransomware logic—purely additive feature. Status files updated. Narrow patch, zero architectural debt.
